items.title: Brandon Aiyuk: Pursuing return to NFL
items.description:
Aiyuk is close to hiring new representation and is expected to file for reinstatement to the NFL in the near future, according to NFL reporter Jordan Schultz.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kyler Murray: Undergoing evaluation on hamstring injury
items.description:
Murray (hamstring), who is dealing with a sore hamstring, is undergoing a full evaluation to determine the extent of the issue, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Josh Jacobs: Expected to remain with team
items.description: Head coach Matt LaFleur said Monday that the Packers are aware of the prior physical abuse allegations involving Jacobs that recently surfaced and "anticipate him being a member" of the team moving forward, Ryan Wood of USA Today reports.

items.title: Daniel Jones: Sticking as starting quarterback
items.description:
Head coach Shane Steichen said that Jones will remain the Colts' starting quarterback heading into Sunday's game against the Colts, Mike Chappell of Fox 59 News Indianapolis reports.

items.title: Jonathon Brooks: Could start practicing soon
items.description:
Panthers head coach Dave Canales said Monday that Brooks (core) will "potentially" be designated for return from injured reserve this week, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.
